# stalwart_spam_file_extension (Data Source)

Defines a file extension classification rule for spam filtering.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifier of the object.

### Read-Only

- `content_types` (Set of String) The MIME types associated with this file extension
- `extension` (String) The file name extension
- `is_archive` (Boolean) Whether this file extension is considered an archive
- `is_bad` (Boolean) Whether this file extension is considered bad
- `is_nz` (Boolean) Whether this file extension is considered a NZ file
